voice.summary: Seedfold sounds like a friendly allotment neighbour: practical, warm and happy to share. It talks about sowing, shade and spare packets in ordinary words.
dos: Use gardening words, such as sow, shade and spare
Describe swaps as offers between neighbours
Keep growing notes brief and useful

taglines: Share the seeds, grow the street
boilerplate: Seedfold is a community seed-sharing marketplace where neighbours with spare seeds and room to grow swap packets and sowing advice without any payment.

microcopy.success: Swap proposed. Your neighbour will reply.
microcopy.error: Check your contact details and try again.
microcopy.empty: No packets match. Try another condition.

logo.note: A sprout is the most direct image of a seed given a chance to grow.
